tasks.title: Spotify Web API Integration & Bridge Overhaul (Scrap go-librespot)

Modernize SpotifyAdapter with official Spotify Web API client credentials (SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID / SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET) and sp_dc/sp_key cookie fallback, high-fidelity metadata resolution, and robust multi-source streaming bridge (SoundCloud/YouTube) with clean doctor checks.

tasks.title: LavaSrc Precision Audio Mirroring (ISRC, Duration Guard & Candidate Scoring)

Prioritize YouTube Music / Topic official audio and eliminate incorrect fuzzy matches from SoundCloud radio/podcast streams.

tasks.title: Audio Queue State Machine, Loop Modes, Audio Filters & Volume Clamping

tasks.title: Voice Connection Lifecycle, Idle Auto-Disconnect & Playlists Repo
tasks.description: @discordjs/voice state machine, reconnection backoff, 3-minute idle timeout auto-disconnect, and MusicRepository (saved playlists & guild settings).

tasks.title: Dual-Dispatch Music Commands Suite (17 Commands)
tasks.description: 17 dual-dispatch music commands with slash and prefix parity (/play, /pause, /resume, /skip, /back, /stop, /queue, /nowplaying, /volume, /loop, /shuffle, /seek, /filter, /lyrics, /join, /leave, /playlist).

tasks.title: Reactive Embed Controller & Interactive Button Matrix (Zero Polling)
tasks.description: Dynamic #music controller embed with responsive 2-row ActionRow buttons (Play/Pause, Skip, Stop, Loop, Volume) updating purely on player/interaction events without setInterval polling.

tasks.title: Lavalink v4 Backend Integration, Autoinstall Script & LavaSrc Setup
tasks.description: Migrate audio streaming core to Lavalink v4 + LavaSrc with an autoinstall setup script, preserving 100% command and embed controller compatibility.

tasks.title: packages/ai Scaffolding, Core Types, Provider Interfaces & Fallback Chain Manager
tasks.description: Initialize packages/ai workspace package with ChatModelProvider interface, ChatRequest/ChatResponse types, token streaming primitives, and FallbackChainManager for 429 quota/timeout auto-failover.

tasks.title: Google Gemini (@google/genai), OpenAI & Ollama Model Adapters with Native Tool Calling
tasks.description: Implement GeminiProvider with @google/genai SDK, OpenAIProvider with openai SDK, and OllamaProvider with native HTTP fetch, supporting streaming responses and structured JSON function tool calling schemas.

tasks.title: AI Conversation Repository, Multi-Dialect Schemas & Strict Per-User Isolation Engine
tasks.description: Build AiRepository over ai_conversations and ai_messages schemas in PostgreSQL and SQLite, enforcing strict (guild_id, user_id, channel_id) isolation to prevent memory leakage across users in shared channels, with sliding-window truncation.

tasks.title: Personality Engine, System Safety Prompts & Sanitized Identity Ingestion
tasks.description: Implement personality engine with customizable guild personas (ai_guild_preferences) separated from immutable system safety instructions, and sanitize user identity tokens (username, display name, guild name) to prevent prompt injection.

tasks.title: Explicit Time Tool (get_current_time) with Multi-Tier Timezone Resolution & Utility Tools
tasks.description: Implement get_current_time tool resolving user timezone -> guild timezone -> UTC, alongside anime search, coinflip, and reminder tool definitions with strict Zod argument schemas.

tasks.title: Application Security Interceptor & Discord Permission-Mediated Tool Calling
tasks.description: Implement security mediation layer ensuring the LLM is never the security boundary: verify caller Discord permissions, module toggle state, bot permissions, and role hierarchy before executing music.play or economy balance checks.

tasks.title: Dedicated #ririko-ai Channel Gateway Listener & Debounced Streaming Message Controller
tasks.description: Implement messageCreate gateway event listener for dedicated #ririko-ai channel (zero prefix/mention required) and non-dedicated mention trigger, with typing indicators and debounced streaming message edits (max 1 edit/1.5s) to avoid Discord rate limits.

tasks.title: Dual-Dispatch AI Commands Suite (/ai chat, /ai model, /ai channel, /ai persona, /ai clear) & Tests
tasks.description: Implement dual-dispatch slash and prefix AI command suite with autocomplete for models/providers, admin configuration commands, session clear, and comprehensive end-to-end integration test coverage.

tasks.title: PermissionService & Discord Punitive Actions Core (Kick, Ban, Softban, Timeout, Lock)
tasks.description: Implement centralized 5-tier permission verification (invoker permissions, bot permissions, invoker role hierarchy, bot role hierarchy, module policy) and execute safe punitive actions (kick, ban, softban, unban, timeout, nick, lock, unlock) with structured action results and event bus emission.

tasks.title: Sequential Case Audit Logger, Staff Notes Manager & Disciplinary History
tasks.description: Implement atomic sequential per-guild case numbering (Case #N), audit case persistence in moderation_cases, rich embed logging to log_channel_id, persistent staff notes in moderation_notes, and full disciplinary history retrieval.

tasks.title: Dynamic Warning Escalation Engine & Sliding-Window Warning Expirations
tasks.description: Implement dynamic warning escalation engine with configurable threshold mappings (warn, timeout, kick, ban), sliding-window active warning expirations (e.g. 30 days), and severity weighting.

tasks.title: Disciplinary Purge & Bulk Message Sanitizer with Multi-Filter Support
tasks.description: Implement filtered bulk message purging (/purge count [user] [invites] [bots] [links]) respecting Discord 14-day API limits with audit log tracking.

tasks.title: AutoMod Rule Pipeline & High-Speed Pattern Engine (Invites, Phishing, Mentions, Spam)
tasks.description: Implement high-speed message evaluation pipeline with invite filter (whitelists), scam and phishing URL shield with homoglyph normalization, mention spam detector, and token-bucket burst spam filter.

tasks.title: Anti-Raid Mass Join Monitor & Automated Server Verification Gate
tasks.description: Implement anti-raid sliding window join monitor detecting coordinated account flood attacks, triggering verification gates, and alerting staff.

tasks.title: Dual-Dispatch Moderation Commands Suite (/warn, /timeout, /kick, /ban, /purge, /lock, etc.)
tasks.description: Implement dual-dispatch slash and prefix moderation commands suite with interactive confirmation components, permission checks, and reason prompts.

tasks.title: Gateway Moderation Listeners, AutoMod Message Pipeline Wiring & Integration Tests
tasks.description: Wire messageCreate and guildMemberAdd gateway listeners to AutoMod and anti-raid engines, with comprehensive end-to-end integration test coverage.

chores.title: Discord Bot Dev Entrypoint, Ping Command & Environment Compatibility
CLI Command to Configure AI Chat Functions & Provider Keys
chores.description: Add ririko ai:configure interactive and flag-based CLI command to configure AI providers (Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama), API keys, models, test connections, and update .env safely.

bugs.title: Fix Silent Audio Player Failure & Implement Real Multi-Source Extractors
bugs.description: Extractors previously returned mock stubs pushing null to Readable streams, causing silent player idle exits. Integrate real audio extraction & fallback streaming for YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, and Deezer.

bugs.title: Spotify Audio Mirroring Hard Artist Gate & Blind Fallback Elimination
bugs.description: Enforce strict hard artist filtering in PrecisionTrackMatcher and eliminate unconstrained SoundCloud title search fallback in YouTubeAdapter to prevent rogue club tracks from streaming.

bugs.title: OpenAI & LLM Providers Function Name Schema Validation & Sanitization
bugs.description: OpenAI API rejects tool function names containing dots (e.g. reminders.create) with 400 error matching ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$. Implement bi-directional tool name sanitization and alias resolution across OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama, and ToolRegistry.

bugs.title: Unfulfilled Assistant Tool Calls in Historical Context Causing OpenAI 400 Error
bugs.description: OpenAI API throws 400 when an assistant message with tool_calls in conversation history is not followed by tool messages for each tool_call_id. Normalize message mapping in OpenAI, Gemini, and Ollama providers to ensure unresponded tool calls are not sent as pending requests.

bugs.title: Duplicate Tool Execution and Unrendered Raw JSON Tool Responses in AI Chat
bugs.description: Fix duplicate tool execution caused by stream/generate fallback condition when tools emit empty text. Feed tool execution results back to the LLM to synthesize natural language responses with clean fallback formatting.

bugs.title: Ignore Prefix Commands in AI Chat & Wire Real Database Values in EconomyBalanceTool
bugs.description: Ignore messages starting with bot command prefix in AI chat controller to prevent duplicate responses to prefix commands. Connect real database economy balance resolver to EconomyBalanceTool.

bugs.title: Wire Real Music Player Execution to MusicPlayTool in AI Chatbot
bugs.description: Connect MusicPlayTool in AI chat to real MusicPlayerService, validating voice channel presence and permissions, joining, queueing audio tracks, and refreshing the active music embed controller.
